description.value: Champions Guild Automation: When you cast a spell, the module offers to spend Channel Divinity on one of these (once per spell): Fortifying Spell - one target gains 2d8 + Cleric level temp HP; Tenacious Spell - when a creature succeeds on a save against the spell, roll 1d6 and subtract it from that save (offered only when it could fail).

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Fortifying / Tenacious Spell offered by the module (spends Channel Divinity).
